key_provisions_or_claims: Much of the AI Act's content concerns personal data processing, since AI must be trained on data.
Guaranteeing data protection under the AI Act will be a major challenge for data protection authorities.
GDPR principles must be ensured in practice; Data Protection Officers need preparation.
UODO will offer expertise in future legislative work on AI.
A separate Sejm subcommittee meeting on data protection and AI is planned.
annotation.summary_en: Press release from Poland's data protection authority (UODO) on its President's remarks to a Sejm subcommittee on AI. He argues the EU AI Act largely involves personal data processing, that GDPR safeguards are essential, and that DPOs and the authority must prepare for enforcement challenges.
annotation.title_clean: Data protection safeguards are important for the safe implementation of the AI Act
annotation.title_en: Data protection safeguards are important for the safe implementation of the AI Act
